entries.12c1e8c8535496e4: This business is conducted by a group consisting of the company, 14 consolidated subsidiaries and one affiliate, and its main business is the development, manufacture and sale of electronic musical instruments. It comprehensively offers a range of product lines including electronic pianos, drums, synthesizers and guitar-related equipment, and is also engaged in integrating "sound" and "video." 91% of the group's revenue (fiscal year ended December 2025) is derived from outside Japan. The head office is located in Shin-Tamada, Hamana-ku, Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture, and consolidated employees numbered 2,897 (as of December 31, 2025).

entries.4bf03d0aa41b37af: This product group includes electronic drums, acoustic drums and electronic wind instruments. Drum Workshop, Inc. in the United States is responsible for development, manufacture and sales of acoustic drums. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥29,364 million, the largest among product categories.
